text:
Alex Chen: Quick sync request — we need a design review for the new "multi-model routing" work that touches API, SDK and Console UX. Target is a 60m session next week to cover RFC, SDK hooks, Console flows, and rollout plan. Pre-read links: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/multi-model-routing, https://redwood.internal/docs/sdk/multi-model-quickstart, Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/multi-model-console-mocks

Alex Chen: Proposed slots (PDT) — please react with :+1: for preferred or reply if blocked:
• Tue 10:00–11:00 (preferred by PM)
• Wed 15:00–16:00
• Thu 09:00–10:00

Alex Chen: Pre-read checklist (please complete before session) — paste into thread when done:
• Read RFC and leave one inline comment on the routing policy section
• Run SDK quickstart: `git clone ... && yarn && yarn demo` — note any API inconsistencies
• Open Console mocks and comment on the canary/rollback UI states in Figma
• Add one or two regression test ideas to the RFC testcases section

Maya Patel: Tue 10 is tough for me (all hands). I can do Wed afternoon or Thu morning.

Jordi Ramos: Wed 15:00 works for me. I'll prepare notes on model variants and fallback behavior, and a short demo of the routing table prototype.

Sanjay Rao: Wed sounds fine. FYI infra needs ~48h to provision the dedicated dev pool if we want a live demo on staging. If we can't, I can record a quick run.

Riley Moore: I can demo the SDK example on Wed. Will add a small sample repo link to pre-read by EOD.

Tom Nguyen: UX note — folks, please check the "rollback state" frame in page 4 of the Figma file. I added alt flows for limited-visibility tenants. Need someone from security to glance.

Lia Gomez: Can we add a quick agenda + success criteria? Proposed: 10m goals/context, 20m API/SDK, 15m Console UX, 10m rollout/ops, 5m next steps. Success criteria: RFC sign-off, defined canary metrics, and an owner for rollout.

Alex Chen: Love that agenda, Lia. Locking Wed 15:00 if no objections by EOD today.

Maya Patel: +1 for Wed. I'll move my conflicts.

Jordi Ramos: +1

Sanjay Rao: +1

Riley Moore: +1 — will upload sample repo at https://git.internal/redwood/multi-model-demo by EOD.

Tom Nguyen: +1 — added a comment in Figma about security note.

ci-bot: Calendar event created: "Design Review — Multi-model routing (API/SDK/Console)" — Wed 15:00 PDT, 60m. Invited: eng-platform, eng, product, ux.

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone. Action items before Wed:
• All: complete pre-read checklist and paste confirmations here
• Jordi/Riley: prepare demo(s); coordinate with Sanjay if you need staging
• Tom: consolidate UX comments and highlight any blockers
• Lia: draft acceptance criteria and candidate rollout metrics

Maya Patel: I'll post my pre-read confirmations tomorrow morning.

Alex Chen: Perfect — will send final calendar invite with agenda + meeting link after EOD.

Sanjay Rao: Note — if anyone needs GPU access for demos, ping me ASAP.

Riley Moore: Posting demo repo now.

Alex Chen: Closing thread for sync scheduling. If you can't make the slot, speak up and we'll re-evaluate. :)
